input: Enroll my toddler in a music and movement class

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The toddler's exact age determines which classes they qualify for, since programs are often segmented by developmental stage (e.g., 0-18 months vs. 2-3 years).
Knowing the city, neighborhood, or whether online is acceptable determines which providers and venues are even viable options.
Available days and times of the week narrow down which class sessions can realistically be attended.
Class costs vary widely from free community programs to $30+ per session; budget determines which options to pursue.
Whether a parent or caregiver attends alongside the toddler affects which class formats are appropriate and logistically feasible.
Priorities like class size, teaching style, or a specific curriculum (e.g., Kindermusik, Music Together, Mommy & Me) shape which programs to shortlist.
Understanding whether the goal is a drop-in trial, a short-term session, or a long-term ongoing enrollment changes how urgently and thoroughly to search.

gold.taskTitle: Enroll toddler in a music and movement class
gold.taskDescription: Find and sign up a toddler for a local or online music and movement class suited to their age and schedule.

questions.title: How old is your toddler right now?
questions.description: The child's exact age in months or years determines age-group eligibility for most music and movement programs.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the class be in?
questions.description: Location (or willingness to do online classes) determines which providers and venues are realistic options.

questions.title: Which days of the week work for attending?
questions.description: Available days and approximate times narrow down which class schedules are actually feasible.

questions.title: What is your budget per class or per month?
questions.description: Class costs range from free community programs to premium paid curricula; budget filters the realistic shortlist.

questions.title: Will a parent or caregiver attend the class too?
questions.description: Whether an adult participates alongside the child determines which class formats (drop-off vs. caregiver-and-me) are appropriate.

questions.title: Do you prefer a specific program style or curriculum?
questions.description: Preferences for a known curriculum (e.g., Music Together, Kindermusik), class size, or teaching approach help prioritize which programs to shortlist.

questions.title: Are you looking for a one-time trial or ongoing enrollment?
questions.description: Whether the goal is a drop-in session, a short seasonal session, or a long-term commitment changes the search strategy and urgency.
